description: Destructive / exfiltration-capable app commands (permissions/destructive-commands.toml): delete_vault, export_backup, configure_backup, run_backup_now, restore_backup, restore_backup_as_new_vault. The commands and plugin grants that swap or restart the running binary (apply_update, relaunch_app, process:allow-restart) are in capabilities/desktop-update.json, desktop platforms only (personal-cfo-i93n3.11). Deliberately a SEPARATE capability from `default` (personal-cfo-3fdd.6, ADR 0010 addendum 2026-07-04): the trusted main window keeps the grant today (there are no other windows yet), but the future isolated windows (document_preview/agent_report — personal-cfo-2no/vrng/z6pn) must NEVER be added here. A compromised renderer in an isolated window then cannot delete the vault, exfiltrate a backup, or reach the update grants even if it somehow reaches the invoke handler.
